title: Basses in Albert's band: Nick Turner, Jimmy Johnson, Harold Holmes
summary: Turner played tuba and valve trombone; the band used three basses.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Let's see if there's anything else we didn't go over. What kind of parts did Nick Turner play? Henry Turner, what was his name?
Nick, Nick played the tuba and doubled on the valve trombone in the brass section.
Mm-hmm. Did he play string bass at all?
No string bass. Just the valve trombone and the sousaphone.
And, uh, can you hear him on the recordings at all or no?
